other_conditions: House construction must be not more than 20 years old for Gold Category
Property must have at least 25% open area (lawn/green area/outside terrace) for Gold Category
Provision for hygienic food storage is required
Adequate parking space inside the premises is required
Owner must have at least one let‑able room and at most six let‑able rooms (maximum 12 beds)
Owner must be physically residing in the same property
Each bedroom must have an attached bathroom with 24‑hour hot and cold water, Western‑style toilet, and proper power, ventilation, and lighting
Premises must be structurally safe, hygienic, clean and meet safety standards
Registered units must maintain standards as per checklist and are subject to surprise inspections
benefits_summary: Offers owners additional income and branding/marketing support from Punjab Tourism, including use of the tourism logo and promotion on official channels.
